Bearing in mind the reasons explained, the application is allowed and the delay in re-filing the appeal is condoned.
The application stands disposed of.

1. This is an appeal under Section 419 of BNSS, 2023filed on behalf of the complainant against the judgment dated 23.11.2024 passed by the learned Sessions Court in case FIR No. 99/2011 titled as "State Vs. Abhishek & Ors" .
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 27/06/2025 at 22:47:52 2.

By virtue of the said judgment, the trial court dismissed the prayer of the prosecution under Section 216 Cr.P.C for addition of charge for the offence under Section 304B/498A/34 IPC against accused Abhishek Jain and Shwetanshu Jain and acquitted them for the offence under Section 306/34 IPC.

It also rejected the prayer of the prosecution to summon the discharged accused Smt.
Sushil Jain under Section 319 Cr.P.C for the offences under Section 304B/498A/306/34 IPC.
3. Issue notice.
4. Notice is accepted by learned APP appearing for the State.
